result.rationale: The diff shows zoho-bigin CalendarService calling refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId) while every other call site (google-calendar, hubspot, lark, office365, zoomvideo, zohocrm, webex, office365video) passes credential.userId. The third parameter is userId per refreshOAuthTokens's signature (userId: number | null) and is sent as calcomUserId to the sync endpoint, so passing credentialId (evidently the credential's id) sends the wrong identifier. This is a verifiable correctness defect introduced by this diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the third parameter is explicitly `userId: number | null` and is sent to the sync endpoint as `calcomUserId`. In the Zoho Bigin integration (`packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`), the call is `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)`, which (by name and unlike other call sites in the diff that pass `credential.userId`) appears to pass a credential identifier instead of the Cal.com user id, causing the sync endpoint to receive the wrong identifier for this app.
